reported_success.quote: Participants having information about another person did not increase belief by the participants that the other person could detect their lie in either the entire sample or an analysis on only those who passed the manipulation check.

notes: Original restriction statistics are in Supplementary Information A.2 p. 3, rather than main-paper p. 3. Replication Table 2 prints Student’s t(268) = -0.64, Welch’s t(261.24) = -0.063, p = 0.95 for each test, and d = -0.008 for both. Student’s printed t appears inconsistent with the other statistics; selected the printed Welch test without correction or conversion.
